invariants.MEX-EXEC-0: No mutation executes without valid MRP clearance (composite_risk < RISK_CEILING)
invariants.MEX-CHAIN-0: Every execution record HMAC-SHA256 chained to prior record
invariants.MEX-HUMAN0-0: HIGH and CRITICAL impact mutations require HUMAN-0 ratification
invariants.MEX-BLAST-0: Execution aborted if blast_radius > MAX_BLAST_RADIUS at apply-time
invariants.MEX-ATOMIC-0: Execution is atomic; partial application triggers auto-rollback
invariants.MEX-ROLLBACK-0: Every executed mutation has a rollback record co-committed in ledger
invariants.MEX-PERSIST-0: Execution ledger is append-only; no record may be modified or deleted
invariants.MEX-DETERM-0: Identical inputs always produce identical execution record fields
invariants.MEX-SCOPE-0: Only ADAAD constitutional scope targets permitted; others raise MEXScopeViolation
